title: No Twisted Text
lyrics:
[Verse]
Why our sound is loud? We sing it proud
Text chat is done
Was a fun run
Comments denoted
Text got fried
Got spun out
Right out

[Pre-Chorus]
Twisted text twisting complete
Ah
Dah
That was so last week
Dah

[Chorus]
Corey
What? What you got? Ah
Like that
Like that
You sang back
"I got your track"
Singing it back
You sang to me
No twisted text on my screen
Just my pumping your beat from your chest to my content
Making my speakers speak
Ah
Dah
This is so this week
We get to speak
Make the bass tones rattle the bones

[Bridge]
But with no twisted text
Sister
We gonna sing with no resistor
Time to escape to a new place
Sandbox text lost
Social media rocked
With a song pal that sings back to me

[Chorus]
What you got?
